label: sdc02_0256_sister_01
text: It’s WAY too dark in here! I just smacked my head\non something![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0256_brother_01
text: That’s ’cause you’re just running around without\nany idea where you’re going![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0256_sister_03
text: Sounds like someone’s finally breaking out of\ntheir funk, hmmm?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0256_brother_03
text: Where’s Ms. Briar, anyway?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0256_sister_04
text: She’s busy rummaging through, like, a whole\nstack of documents over there.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0256_brother_04
text: Aren’t those someone’s private photos and stuff?\nWe probably shouldn’t be looking at all that...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0256_sister_05
text: Huh, you’re awfully considerate all of a sudden.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0256_sister_06
text: Ms. Briar, look! An elevator! Maybe it can take\nus further down? You wanted to go down, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0256_bbteacher_01
text: “Down,” you say?![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0256_bbteacher_02
text: Oh my! Did you use this elevator last time to\nreach the mysterious room I mentioned earlier?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0256_select_01
text: Sure did!

label: sdc02_0256_select_02
text: I...think so?

label: sdc02_0256_bbteacher_03
text: How exciting![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0256_bbteacher_04
text:
Oh? Did you already forget what happened last
time you were here?\c
Perhaps this is a side effect of prolonged
exposure to Area Zero...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0256_bbteacher_05
text: Well, we’ve no time to waste. Let’s go down![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0256_sister_07
text: From what I’m hearing, you’ve already been on\nmore adventures than I can count.\c\nNo wonder you’re so level-headed all the time.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0256_bbteacher_07
text: Come now, let’s keep making our way down![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
